_comment: Reviewed expectations for `tracefold news validate-candidate --expectations` (#81).
The corpus is a mechanical export of what happened; this file is the human judgment about what should have
happened. It lives in git so it is reviewable, and it is part of the trusted root: no automated proposal
path may write it.
must_push — the reader had to receive this fact. Only mark a case the pipeline decided to send and a rule
withheld; a card the model itself called noise is unrecoverable by any policy and marking it would only
deadlock the gate. Two entries below are still failing under the shipped policy on purpose: they are the
standing recall debt, which `evidence.boundary.open` reprints on every run.
may_drop — the reader should not have received this; it repeats a card already delivered.
